geometryObservation.implication: Use explicit coordinate transforms; do not copy AppKit frame coordinates directly into CoreGraphics geometry.

interpretation.confirmed: Private managed display scopes matched public display UUIDs in both samples; one matched screen had 3 Space records and the other had 1 while screensHaveSeparateSpaces was false.
interpretation.notProven: The 3+1 records are not proven to be 4 independent user-facing Spaces. Shared-Space semantics and transition behavior remain unresolved.
interpretation.windowMembership: All on-screen positive-bounds layer-zero windows in both samples had non-empty membership; only a subset of all layer-zero records had non-empty membership. The rest are unclassified, not proven to be invalid.

limits: Read-only inventory only; no Space switching or window activation tested.
No display hot-plug, mirroring, Stage Manager, full-screen transition, or separate-Spaces-on configuration tested.
Raw private Space type values are recorded without assigning semantics.
Private SkyLight APIs are undocumented and version-sensitive.
Raw JSON containing display UUIDs, monitor names, and window geometry remains local and is not included in this public repository summary.
